issues.on_page: Statement of Activities general revenues: Property Taxes 7,061,049; Sales Taxes 14,246,924; Other Taxes 283,645 (sum 21,591,618, accrual basis)
issues.issue: The report does print a tax-type breakdown (p4), but it is accrual basis and is 245,600 more than the fund-statement Taxes line, so it can't be used as an exact split_from. Keeping the line unlabeled is defensible, but it hides about 14.2M of sales tax (most of the city's taxes). Someone needs to decide whether to split it in proportion or leave it unlabeled. This isn't in decision_needed[].

The label says what the line is (repayments on CDBG/LB840 loans), so it isn't an unexplained miscellaneous line. No category fits exactly (reimbursements/refunds is the closest), so 'other' with review is defensible. The same applies to detail[37] (CDBG Loan Repayments 122,204, p12) and detail[53] (LB 840 Loan Repayments 2,000, p14).

issues.on_page: Community Development Block Grant Fund - Intergovernmental Revenue 31,950
issues.issue: The high-level category doesn't match detail_category. If CDBG is treated as federal, category should be 'federal grants'. If it is treated as state pass-through aid, detail_category should be 'other state aid'.

The arithmetic is correct and marked computed. However, Information Technology Subscriptions (39,769) is a subscription-based IT financing (SBITA), which works like lease or debt proceeds and could go in debt_proceeds instead. This is a judgment call.
